verdict.rationale: Slack's own AI page states that AI in Slack can summarize channels and threads and serve up daily recaps (slack-docs-15). It also describes a 'Today' intelligent briefing (slack-docs-13) and AI huddle notes (slack-docs-19). This directly matches the story, but the evidence is a single marketing-level claim without in-depth documentation. missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on how channel and thread summaries and recaps work (scope, controls, plan availability), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
